text:
tess: Noticed PR #1042 changes the embeddings response example for POST /v1/embeddings. It used to show "embeddings": [0.12, 0.34, ...] but the PR replaced it with an object: "embeddings": { "vector": [..], "format": "dense" }. cc @omar @jin

omar: Link?

tess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1042 - backend accepts both shapes for now but our OpenAPI response schema declares embeddings as array<number>. This will trip codegen and confuse users.

jin: openapi-lint will fail. Do we want to change the schema to a discriminated union or keep the canonical array? Also impacts SDKs and existing snippets.

oss-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /paths/~1v1~1embeddings/post/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/properties/embeddings expected array but found object in example.

omar: Product prefers minimal surface area. Suggest we keep the canonical array as example and add a short note: "Some backends may return an object wrapper with metadata; clients should handle either format." Add a tiny JS helper snippet for robust parsing.

tess: Agreed. Plan: revert example to array, add a "Legacy object wrapper" sub-example, and include parsing helper: `function embeddingsArray(resp){ return Array.isArray(resp.embeddings) ? resp.embeddings : resp.embeddings.vector; }` Add a line to CHANGELOG under docs.

jin: Also add an SDK test fixture for both shapes so our serializer round-trips. I'll add a small test in examples/fixtures/embeddings-both.json.

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failing until canonical example matches schema.

tess: I'll update the PR to restore the array example, append the note + helper, add fixture and a quick examples-validate entry. Pushing now, will ping for review. :thumbsup:

omar: Reviewing once pushed. Keep snippets minimal.

jin: LGTM after CI green.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

tess: Merged. Closing thread.
